test_suite: Better Auth Authentication & Session Readiness Audit

verified_capabilities.requirement: Session cookies must use __Secure- prefix when deployed over HTTPS
verified_capabilities.observed_behavior: __Secure-better-auth.session_token cookie transmitted and parsed over HTTPS

verified_capabilities.requirement: Session cookies must specify HttpOnly attribute to prevent XSS exfiltration
verified_capabilities.observed_behavior: Set-Cookie response headers include HttpOnly flag

verified_capabilities.requirement: Session cookies must specify SameSite=Lax or SameSite=Strict to prevent CSRF
verified_capabilities.observed_behavior: SameSite=Lax enforced on session cookie generation

verified_capabilities.requirement: Better Auth must validate origin matches BETTER_AUTH_URL and reject untrusted origins
verified_capabilities.observed_behavior: Untrusted callback origins rejected with HTTP 400

verified_capabilities.requirement: Sessions expire after configured duration (7 days default)
verified_capabilities.observed_behavior: Expired session tokens return HTTP 401 unauthenticated status

verified_capabilities.requirement: Signing out revokes token from database session table

verified_capabilities.observed_behavior: Unauthenticated requests receive HTTP 307 redirect to /login

verified_capabilities.requirement: Unauthenticated API requests return HTTP 401 JSON response
verified_capabilities.observed_behavior: API routes return HTTP 401 with sanitized error payload

verified_capabilities.requirement: Authenticated session for Tenant A querying Tenant B resource returns HTTP 404
verified_capabilities.observed_behavior: Enforces tenant boundary isolation across all business, bill, session, inspection, and action queries

verified_capabilities.requirement: Zero session tokens, cookies, or BETTER_AUTH_SECRET values logged
verified_capabilities.observed_behavior: Structured logs redact sensitive headers and secret parameters

production_assumptions.assumption: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET in production will be a randomly generated 32+ character high-entropy secret
production_assumptions.status: PROPOSED TARGET — PRODUCT OWNER DECISION REQUIRED

production_assumptions.assumption: BETTER_AUTH_URL in production will match the production HTTPS domain
production_assumptions.status: PROPOSED TARGET — PRODUCT OWNER DECISION REQUIRED
